name: NGC 2726, SN 1995F field (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 2726, a spiral galaxy and host of SN 1995F, seen by Hubble.
label: sn1995fhost-hubble
story: A spiral galaxy that hosted SN 1995F, most likely a Type Ic supernova. Found at Saint Mary's University's Burke-Gaffney Observatory, it was the first supernova discovered from within Canada.

claims.text: SN 1995F was most likely of type Ic
NGC 2726 is a spiral galaxy (type Sa)
SN 1995F was discovered at the Burke-Gaffney Observatory of Saint Mary's University
SN 1995F was the first discovery of a supernova from within Canada
